summary: Operator site, its 2025 site map and photos, Google and imagery read; Campspot refused today (CloudFront 403), the 2026-10-13 capture used. Lakeview confirmed (not upgraded). Season May 15-Oct 20 confirmed (manual); booking adds the 9-night limit and holiday 3-night minimum; facilities confirmed. Water hookups conflict between the city's page and Campspot - flagged, not changed.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT. The camping loops sit under continuous hardwood canopy on a drumlin; the nearest RV sites (27, 26, 3 on the 2025 map; around 43.8418,-88.9665) are about 60-80 m from Green Lake's shore with S. Lawson Drive and a lakeside parking strip between, so no site is waterfront. The pond behind (NE, weed-covered on imagery) is reached only by tent sites 36-39 near the boat launch. The operator's photo from the camp hill shows the lake through the trees, which supports the view. Campspot tags its '30 amp RV' type with 'Waterfront Site' - an operator tag, but imagery and the city's own map put a public road between every site and the lake, so it does not earn lakefront.

HOOKUPS CONFLICT: the city's page says 'Electric Hook up only, No water hook ups available', while the 2026-10-13 Campspot capture lists three types named '+ Water' (8 sites) with 'Water Hook-Up'. Stored water:true (from Campspot) left alone; reviewer to choose, or the city's page is stale.
RATE: the city's page says 'Camping rates start at $36/night plus tax'; stored $38-52 (Campspot October 2026) left as is. Local - no price gate.
MINIMUM: 3-night minimum on holiday stays only - not a standing minimum.
PIN 43.8412,-88.9669 is ~70 m south of the loops' centre (43.8418,-88.9668): fine.
